summary.cross_cutting_observations: The diagnostic agent in track A_flat was severely handicapped by a malfunctioning LLM SQL sub-agent. In many cases, the SQL tool either failed to execute (returning raw SQL queries) or hallucinated highly detailed, completely fabricated tables matching the scenario descriptions. The orchestrator frequently took these hallucinated logs at face value, which sometimes accidentally led to correct root causes on faulty traces, but systematically caused the agent to invent faults for normal Tier 0 control traces. When the SQL tool returned raw strings, the orchestrator occasionally fabricated log evidence entirely on its own.
